![Photo by [Jakob Rosen](https://unsplash.com/@jakobnoahrosen?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=referral) on [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com?utm_source=medium&utm_medium=referral)](image-1.jpg){fig-alt="Photo by Jakob Rosen on Unsplash"}

I understand the pain

Like your soul

concentrated

traveling through your veins.

But brother, let me explain

I too loved her

adored

it was all in vain.

Her loss is ours to gain

come with me

traverse

and drink ourselves insane.
